verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's docs say automation runs produce 'Cloud-visible' coding sessions and that remote tasks can be controlled from app.humanlayer.com on a machine or phone. That implies you can see sessions as they run, but the docs never describe a live activity view or a status indicator for a running agent. missing for 10: explicit real-time activity streaming of agent actions, documented current-status indicators for running sessions, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment
You will control the task from app.humanlayer.com on a machine or phone.
